basics.description: Deploy Azure Resource Health alerts for Azure VMware Solution private clouds. Fires on availability state transitions (Unavailable, Degraded, Unknown) — first-party Azure platform signal, no Log Analytics dependency. Catches outages even when syslog ingestion has stopped.

basics.name: alertName
basics.label: Alert Name
basics.toolTip: Base name for the Resource Health alert rules.

constraints.validationMessage: Only letters, numbers, and hyphens. Max 50 characters.

basics.name: alertScope
basics.label: Alert Scope (Resource ID)
basics.toolTip: Optional. Leave blank to monitor every AVS private cloud in this subscription. Or paste a resource group ID (/subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}) or a specific AVS private cloud resource ID (/subscriptions/{sub}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds/{name}) to scope tighter.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be empty (subscription scope) or a valid Azure resource ID for a subscription, resource group, or Microsoft.AVS/privateClouds resource.

basics.name: actionGroupSelector
basics.label: Action Group
basics.toolTip: Select the action group to notify when AVS resource health changes.

options.text: Resource Health states map to Azure Monitor severity: Unavailable = Sev 0, Degraded = Sev 1, Unknown = Sev 2. Unknown is disabled by default — it can fire on transient telemetry blips. Enable after baselining.

basics.name: monitorDegraded
basics.label: Degraded (Sev 1) — partial impact (vSAN capacity, host failure)

basics.name: monitorUnknown
basics.label: Unknown (Sev 2) — telemetry issue or precursor to Unavailable (off by default)
